name: Abendego's Squall (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: A massive orca known as Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.
disable: DC 23 Medicine (trained) to remove the harpoon, DC 21 Nature (trained) to calm the orca, or DC 23 Intimidation (trained) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
routine:
d Abendego's Squall thrashes against the hull of the Snapdragon. With each action, it makes a flipper Strike against a PC adjacent to the railing. Whenever it makes a flipper Strike, it also deals its Strike damage to the ship whether or not the Strike was successful.

Speed 30 feet

offensiveAbilities.name: Thar She Blows
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Abendego's Squall matches speed with the Snapdragon

Effect The orca leaps across the Snapdragon and tears its main mast from the deck in the process. This deals 30] damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on deck take @Damage 2d8[bludgeoning Damage damage from the shrapnel and must attempt a Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save. Abendego's Squall rolls initiative.
